lines.en: label day244:
scene utapoachesio1
: Poke.
: Pokey-poke poke.
lines.zh: : 戳戳、戳戳。

lines.en: : Pokey-pokey-pokey-pokey-poke.
lines.zh: : 戳戳戳戳戳戳戳戳戳。

lines.en: So, I bet you’re wondering how I found myself in this situation.
lines.zh: 那么，我猜你一定很好奇我是怎么落到这步田地的。

lines.en: It was a normal day of[school] just like any other.
lines.zh: 那是和往常一模一样、普普通通的一天[school]生活。

lines.en: In fact, it was so normal that it ended without any hiccups and this onslaught of poking came out of virtually nowhere.
lines.zh: 事实上，它普通到毫无波折地就结束了，而这波戳戳攻势完全是凭空冒出来的。

lines.en: Yup.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: I know you were expecting a little more detail as to why this small female is now walking alongside me and-
lines.zh: 我知道你期待我再多交代点细节，比如为什么这个小小的女生现在会走在我旁边，还有——

lines.en: : Pokey-poke.
lines.zh: : 戳戳。

lines.en: And doing that.
lines.zh: 还有在做这个。

lines.en: But I really have no idea.
lines.zh: 但我真的不知道。

lines.en: : Is there something you need from me, Uta?
lines.zh: : 你找我有什么事吗，Uta？

lines.en: : You mean I can’t just walk side by side with you and poke you without any ulterior motives?
lines.zh: : 您的意思是，我不能没有别的目的、就只是跟您并肩走一路、戳您一路？

lines.en: : Is that what’s happening right now?
lines.zh: : 那现在是在干嘛？

lines.en: : No. I have an ulterior motive.
lines.zh: : 不。我确实有目的。

lines.en: : And what might that ulterior motive be, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那请问是什么目的呢？

lines.en: : You see, Sensei. I’ve got this really good friend who transferred in alongside me...
lines.zh: : 您看，Sensei。我有一个特别好的朋友，是跟我一起转过来的……

lines.en: : And I was just thinking that you would be my favorite person in the whole wide world if you’d be able to...oh, I don’t know-
lines.zh: : 我刚刚在想，如果您能……哦，我也不知道——那您就是全世界我最喜欢的人了。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio2
: Get her into our class?
lines.zh: : 把她弄进我们班？

lines.en: : And you think poking me on the way home from[school] is the way to accomplish that?
lines.zh: : 而你觉得，在[school]放学回家的路上戳我，就能办成这件事？

lines.en: : Would you prefer I did something a little...extra?
lines.zh: : 那您是希望我做点更……进一步的事？

lines.en: : What did you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 你脑子里想的是什么？

lines.en: scene utapoachesio3
: Ah! You thought I was being serious!
lines.zh: : 啊！您还真以为我是认真的！

lines.en: : You thought I was offering to do freaky stuff with you just now!
lines.zh: : 您以为我刚刚是在提议跟您做那种色色的事！

lines.en: : Why do you torment me like this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这么折磨我？

lines.en: scene utapoachesio4
: I’m sorry, Sensei. But I’m afraid that it is too cold and too wet to be doing freaky stuff right now.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Sensei。但恐怕现在又冷又湿，实在不适合做色色的事。

lines.en: : Plus, this is the only uniform I have and I can't afford it getting all messy.
lines.zh: : 而且我只有这一套制服，弄脏了可赔不起。

lines.en: : So I’m very sorry but I’m going to have to reject you once again.
lines.zh: : 所以非常抱歉，我只能再一次拒绝您了。

lines.en: : Please do not hold this against me. I hope we can continue to remain friends.
lines.zh: : 请您不要因此记恨我。希望我们还能继续做朋友。

lines.en: : Hah...
: What is your friend’s name?
lines.zh: : 你那个朋友叫什么名字？

lines.en: scene utapoachesio5
: Ah! Are you actually gonna do it?!
lines.zh: : 啊！您真的要帮忙吗？！

lines.en: : Oh my God! I love you! You’re the best ever!
lines.zh: : 我的天哪！我爱您！您是世界上最好的！

lines.en: : I never agreed to anything. I don’t even know if something like that is in my power.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没答应。我甚至不知道这种事是不是我能决定的。

lines.en: : Really? Cause I talked to her teacher and she said that she’s fine with you taking pretty much everybody out of her class if you want.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？因为我跟她的老师聊过了，她说只要您愿意，她班上您想带走谁都行。

lines.en: : Does your friend’s teacher have purple hair and look like she hasn’t slept in ten years?
lines.zh: : 你朋友的老师是不是紫色头发，而且看起来像十年没睡过觉？

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Just like that, actually.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯。真的就是这样。

lines.en: : Then...maybe there is something I can do after all.
lines.zh: : 那……也许我还真能做点什么。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio6
: Yay!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: : Just so you know though, I still can’t get freaky. I’ve barely even settled into my dorm and I wouldn’t even know where to go for something like that.
lines.zh: : 不过先说清楚，我还是不能做色色的事。我宿舍才刚安顿好，而且我根本不知道该去哪儿做那种事。

lines.en: : I have a house, you know.
lines.zh: : 我有房子，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio7
: Ooooooh you sly dog, you. Offering to take a [young_girl] home on her way out of[school].
lines.zh: : 哦——您这只老狐狸。居然提议在[school]放学路上把一个[young_girl]带回家。

lines.en: : Don’t you live with Ami? Won’t she get jealous?
lines.zh: : 您不是和 Ami 住一起吗？她不会吃醋吗？

lines.en: scene utapoachesio8
: Wait! You want both of us! At the same time!
lines.zh: : 等等！您想两个都要！还同时！

lines.en: : And in our uniforms!
lines.zh: : 还穿着制服！

lines.en: : I see right through you, Sensei! I had no idea you-
lines.zh: : 我把您看透了，Sensei！我真不知道您——

lines.en: : You really need to tone it down while we’re still on[school] grounds.
lines.zh: : 我们还在[school]校园里，你真该收敛点。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio9
: Yeah, probably. The more I think about it, the more we risk having one of your eleven-hundred girlfriends see us.
lines.zh: : 是，大概吧。越想越觉得，万一被您那一千一百个女朋友里的哪一个看见就糟了。

lines.en: : I already lost my first fight to Yumi. I need to train before I’m ready to take on another opponent.
lines.zh: : 我已经输给 Yumi 第一场了。我得先练练，才能挑战下一个对手。

lines.en: : Right...
: This friend, though-
lines.zh: : 不过说到你那个朋友——

lines.en: scene utapoachesio10
: Oh, yeah!
lines.zh: : 哦，对！

lines.en: : I was actually thinking, if you aren’t too busy today, the two of us could go pay her a visit so you can get a feel for her.
lines.zh: : 我在想，如果您今天不忙的话，我们俩可以去找她，让您先感受一下她这个人。

lines.en: : Not like a literal feel, though.
lines.zh: : 当然不是字面意义上的感受。

lines.en: : She doesn’t have to call her parents for approval or anything the way I do, but she’s not really a big people-person.
lines.zh: : 她不像我，做什么都不用先打电话征得爸妈同意，但她不太擅长跟人打交道。

lines.en: : But hey, who knows? You seem to draw in girls my age, so maybe she’ll be calling you Master soon, too?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，谁知道呢？您好像特别招我这个年纪的女生，说不定她很快也会叫您 Master 了？

lines.en: : Just in the good way and stuff.
lines.zh: : 当然是好的那种意思啦。

lines.en: : You really don’t hold anything back in public conversation, do you?
lines.zh: : 你在公共场合说话是真的一点都不遮拦啊。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio11
: My lack of a filter will one-day be my demise.
lines.zh: : 我这张没把门的嘴总有一天会害死我。

lines.en: : But until then, please continue taking care of me~
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，请继续照顾我吧~

lines.en: I will take care of you forever, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: 我会永远照顾你的，Uta。

lines.en: : I don’t have any plans today, so we can go meet her if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 我今天没什么安排，想的话我们现在就去见她。

lines.en: : Where does she live?
lines.zh: : 她住哪儿？

lines.en: scene utapoachesio12
: You know that bathhouse somewhere between the maid cafe and the[school]? There.
lines.zh: : 您知道女仆咖啡店和[school]之间那家澡堂吧？就那儿。

lines.en: : She lives in a bathhouse?
lines.zh: : 她住在澡堂里？

lines.en: : Mhm. Her aunt owns the place and she helps run it.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她阿姨是那儿的老板，她帮忙打理。

lines.en: : She’s probably working right now, but as long as you don’t mind naked people walkin’ around all...naked and stuff, we can hang out there.
lines.zh: : 她现在大概在干活，不过只要您不介意有人在旁边光着身子……走来走去什么的，我们可以在那儿待着。

lines.en: : I don’t mind naked people at all. I actually prefer them.
lines.zh: : 我一点也不介意光着身子的人。说实话我还更喜欢呢。

lines.en: Which is something I can safely say now that there are virtually zero men anywhere to be found.
lines.zh: 反正现在这地方几乎找不到一个男人，说这种话还是很安全的。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio10
: Then all aboard the Uta-Express!
lines.zh: : 那就登上 Uta 号特快列车吧！

lines.en: : Just not like aboard-aboard, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 但不是「登」上「登」上的那种，您懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : Right. Because you’d have to call your parents.
lines.zh: : 懂。因为你得先给爸妈打电话。

lines.en: : Yeah. This train’s out of service and can’t take on any passengers right now. Sorry, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没错。这趟列车现在停运，暂时不能载客。抱歉啦，Sensei。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if I love or hate all of these innuendos.
lines.zh: : 我真分不清自己是喜欢还是讨厌这些黄段子。

lines.en: : You love ‘em. I can see it in those big ole’ pretty eyes of yours.
lines.zh: : 您喜欢。我从您那双又大又漂亮的眼睛里看得出来。

lines.en: : Now, come on! We’ve gotta get there before all the old ladies show up and start playin’ strip mahjong in the back room!
lines.zh: : 好啦，快走吧！我们得赶在那群老太太来之前到，不然她们就要在后屋开始打脱衣麻将了！

lines.en: : Is that...actually a thing that happens there?
lines.zh: : 那……那儿真会发生这种事吗？

lines.en: : Probably. You know how old ladies get.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。您知道老太太们都什么德行。

lines.en: scene black
What Uta does not know is that...I don’t know how old ladies get.
lines.zh: Uta 不知道的是……我并不知道老太太们是什么德行。

lines.en: How is that even a thing I would know?
lines.zh: 我怎么会知道那种事？

lines.en: I’ve made it overwhelmingly apparent that I hardly ever associate with anyone out of Uta’s age group- which sounds kind of sickening when I actually put it into words.
lines.zh: 我已经表现得再明显不过了：我几乎从不和 Uta 这个年龄段以外的人来往——这话真说出来，听着还挺恶心的。

lines.en: But that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: 不过这不是重点。

lines.en: The matter at hand is meeting this friend of hers- who may or may not wind up making my life just as difficult as Uta is.
lines.zh: 眼下的事是去见她这个朋友——她可能会、也可能不会像 Uta 一样把我的日子搅得鸡犬不宁。

lines.en: The girl’s barely left my side since she showed up in[school].
lines.zh: 这丫头自从出现在这所[school]起，就几乎没离开过我身边。

lines.en: And, even though I don’t really have any problem with that, maybe having someone else she knows around will get her to...ease up a bit?
lines.zh: 虽然我其实并不介意，但也许身边多一个她认识的人，能让她……稍微收敛一点？

lines.en: But, then again, there’s a chance that this will all just crash and burn in the end.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这事也有可能最后彻底玩完。

lines.en: I guess I’ll just have to wait and see.
lines.zh: 我想我只能等着看了。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio13
Uta leads me into the bathhouse that I’ve been to with Ami and Ayane several times before.
lines.zh: Uta 领着我走进那家澡堂，我之前和 Ami、Ayane 来过好几次。

lines.en: She stops walking abruptly and quickly turns to face me. I can see her friend out of the corner of my eye and I’m slightly confused as to why we’ve yet to approach her.
lines.zh: 她突然停下脚步，迅速转过身面对我。我用余光看见了她的朋友，有点不明白我们为什么还没过去。

lines.en: : Welp. Time to get naked, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那个。该脱光了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Like, both of us?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我们两个都脱？

lines.en: : Nope. Just you.
lines.zh: : 不。就您一个。

lines.en: : It’s a bathhouse. It’s bad manners to be walking around in your normal clothes.
lines.zh: : 这可是澡堂。穿着常服到处走是很失礼的。

lines.en: : But you-
lines.zh: : 可你——

lines.en: : My friend works here. I don’t have to follow the rules.
lines.zh: : 我朋友在这儿工作。我不用守规矩。

lines.en: : Something tells me I should not be falling for this trick.
lines.zh: : 直觉告诉我，我不该上这个当。

lines.en: : Something tells me somebody is a little self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 直觉告诉我，有个人有点不好意思了呢。

lines.en: : That is definitely not what’s happening right now.
lines.zh: : 现在绝对不是那么回事。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio14
: I’m just messin’ with you anyway. But you can’t blame me for being kinda curious.
lines.zh: : 反正我就是在逗您玩。不过我有点好奇，您也不能怪我吧。

lines.en: : Now, come on! I’ll introduce you to Io.
lines.zh: : 好啦，走吧！我介绍您认识 Io。

lines.en: scene black
I shrug off the fact that Uta just...openly admitted to being curious about my penis (?) and follow her to the counter.
lines.zh: 我对 Uta 刚刚……公开承认对我的阴茎感到好奇（？）这件事耸耸肩不予理会，跟着她走向柜台。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio15
: Welp, here she is! Ain’t she a beaut?
lines.zh: : 那个，就是她！是不是个美人？

lines.en: : Yeah, she's adorable.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她很可爱。

lines.en: : Am I...being appraised right now?
lines.zh: : 我……现在是在被人估价吗？

lines.en: : Sure are, Io.
lines.zh: : 没错啊，Io。

lines.en: : But anyway, meet Sensei. He’s the best teacher I’ve ever had and I’ve only been in his class for a week.
lines.zh: : 不过说正事，这位就是 Sensei。他是我遇到过最好的老师，虽然我才在他班上一个星期。

lines.en: : Aren’t you that guy who rented out the men’s bath with that one blonde girl a while ago?
lines.zh: : 你不就是之前包下男汤、跟那个金发女生在一起的那个人吗？

lines.en: : I was really hoping you wouldn’t have remembered that.
lines.zh: : 我还真希望你没记住那件事。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio16
: Blonde girl?!
lines.zh: : 金发女生？！

lines.en: : Natural blonde or bleach-blonde?!
lines.zh: : 天生金发还是染的？！

lines.en: : That’s the part you want to know more about?...
lines.zh: : 你想多了解的是这个部分？……

lines.en: : I’ve gotta know if it was Ayane or Chika! I need to update your hit-list!
lines.zh: : 我必须知道是 Ayane 还是 Chika！我得更新一下您的猎艳名单！

lines.en: : What if it wasn’t someone from the class?
lines.zh: : 万一不是班上的呢？

lines.en: scene utapoachesio17
: Ah! You scoundrel! How many girls are you seeing?!
lines.zh: : 啊！您这个混蛋！您到底在跟多少女生交往？！

lines.en: scene utapoachesio18
: So like...are you guys here to take baths...or?
lines.zh: : 那个……你们是来泡澡的……还是？

lines.en: : What’s going on right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Oh, no. We’re here for the naked mahjong game with the old ladies in the back.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。我们是来参加后屋老太太们的脱衣麻将局的。

lines.en: : How many times do I have to tell you that isn’t a thing we do here?
lines.zh: : 我要说多少次，我们这儿根本不干那种事？

lines.en: : I just don’t believe you, Io. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我就是不信你，Io。抱歉啦。

lines.en: : Uta here was trying to get you into my class.
lines.zh: : Uta 是想把你弄进我的班。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio19
: She was?
lines.zh: : 她是？

lines.en: : Yup!
: But...why?
lines.zh: : 可是……为什么？

lines.en: : I...actually didn’t ask that.
lines.zh: : 我……其实没问这个。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio20
: You’ve just seemed really down the last few days and I thought it might pep you up a bit being around me and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你最近几天看起来一直很低落，我就想着，你要是能跟我待在一起什么的，说不定会精神点。

lines.en: : I know how hard it can be making friends in new-
lines.zh: : 我知道在新环境里交朋友有多难——

lines.en: scene utapoachesio21
: Ugh. Uta, come on. Not this again.
lines.zh: : 呃。Uta，别这样。又来了。

lines.en: : No, no, no! Hear me out. Sensei is actually a super awesome teacher and already said he’d be fine with taking you into the class.
lines.zh: : 不不不！听我说完。Sensei 真的是个超棒的老师，而且他已经说了，把你收进班里完全没问题。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio22
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess that’s kind of what happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大概就是这么回事吧。

lines.en: : But why? You don’t even know me.
lines.zh: : 但为什么？你根本不认识我。

lines.en: : I could like, be a serial killer or something.
lines.zh: : 我说不定是个连环杀手什么的呢。

lines.en: : Uta vouched for you so that’s good enough for me.
lines.zh: : Uta 替你担保了，对我来说就足够了。

lines.en: : But also, since I’m going out of my way for you-
lines.zh: : 不过，既然我都特意为你跑这一趟了——

lines.en: : You want me to keep the thing about you and the blonde girl a secret?
lines.zh: : 你想要我替你和那个金发女生的事保密？

lines.en: : Preferably, yes.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，是的。

lines.en: : Sure. Do whatever you want. I'm not a big fan of secrets but if that's all it takes, sure.
lines.zh: : 行。你想怎样都行。我不太喜欢保守秘密，不过如果只是这样就行，那没问题。

lines.en: : Your business is your business after all.
lines.zh: : 反正你的事就是你的事。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. You’re the complete opposite of Uta.
lines.zh: : 哦，不错。你跟 Uta 完全相反。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio23
: Why is that cool?! You love me! I was ready to get freaky after this!
lines.zh: : 这有什么好的？！您明明最爱我！我本来还准备待会儿就做色色的事呢！

lines.en: : No you weren’t.
lines.zh: : 你才没有。

lines.en: : She hasn’t even called her parents yet.
lines.zh: : 她连爸妈都还没打电话呢。

lines.en: : See? You’re not the only one who can see through people, Uta.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？能把人看透的不止你一个，Uta。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio24
: I have so much love to give and no one who will accept it...
lines.zh: : 我有那么多的爱要给出，却没有一个人愿意接受……

lines.en: : Um...is there like, anything you need from me to help out with the transfer thing?
lines.zh: : 呃……转班这件事，有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

lines.en: : Dying to get out that badly?
lines.zh: : 这么想逃出去？

lines.en: : I mean...Yeah, a little bit I guess.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……嗯，大概是有那么一点。

lines.en: : I’m not going to drop out or anything if I stay in Ms. Watabe’s class, but I’d definitely like being around at least one person I know more than...zero of them.
lines.zh: : 就算留在 Watabe 老师班上，我也不至于退学什么的，但身边能有一个认识的人，总比……一个都没有强。

lines.en: : Also, you’d be the first teacher I’ve ever gotten to see the penis of and that sounds like a fun novelty.
lines.zh: : 而且，你会是我见过的第一个被我看到阴茎的老师，听起来还挺新鲜的。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio25
: Oh great. So that’s a thing you saw.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。所以那东西你还真看见了。

lines.en: : What?! Io!
lines.zh: : 什么？！Io！

lines.en: : Your aunt says you’re only supposed to watch the cameras when people are up to no good!
lines.zh: : 你阿姨说，只有别人图谋不轨的时候你才该盯着监控看！

lines.en: : He’s an older guy who got into a bath with a girl my age. Of course I was going to think he was up to no good.
lines.zh: : 一个大老爷们跟我同龄的女生一起泡澡，我当然会觉得他不怀好意。

lines.en: : Surprisingly, though, nothing happened at all.
lines.zh: : 不过意外的是，什么都没发生。

lines.en: : They just sat back to back and talked to each other for like two whole hours.
lines.zh: : 他们就是背靠着背坐着，聊了整整两个小时。

lines.en: To be fair, I was totally down to do more than that but Ayane didn’t seem like she was in the best state of mind that night.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我当时是很想做点更多的，但 Ayane 那晚看起来状态不太好。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio26
: Really, though. If there’s anything I can do to help make this happen, just ask.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，如果想让这事成，有什么我能帮忙的尽管开口。

lines.en: : The more I think about getting out of Ms. Watabe's, the more psyched up I’m getting.
lines.zh: : 我越想能从 Watabe 老师班上逃出去，就越兴奋。

lines.en: : I’ve always done better with male teachers anyway so this is like, a totally awesome idea.
lines.zh: : 反正我本来就更容易跟男老师相处，所以这主意简直棒极了。

lines.en: : Will a discount on bath-stuff sweeten the deal?! Oh! Should I throw in Uta?!
lines.zh: : 给泡澡用品打个折能不能让这事儿更好谈？！哦！要不要把 Uta 也搭进去？！

lines.en: : Disclaimer: Uta is not for sale. Please keep your hands in the vehicle at all times.
lines.zh: : 免责声明：Uta 是非卖品。请全程把双手放在车内。

lines.en: : That won’t be necessary.
lines.zh: : 这就不用了。

lines.en: : I’ll do what I can but I can’t guarantee it will work out.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力，但不能保证一定办得成。

lines.en: : I’ve taken in transfer students before but I’ve never stolen one from another class.
lines.zh: : 我以前接收过转学生，但从没从别的班挖过一个。

lines.en: : It’s not really stealing if it’s what I want, though, right? You can just tell them I’m not happy in the other class or something.
lines.zh: : 不过如果这是我自己愿意的，那就不算偷吧？你就跟他们说我在原来那个班不开心之类的就行了。

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe is kind of a creep anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正 Watabe 老师也有点瘆人。

lines.en: : She’s definitely...unique.
lines.zh: : 她确实……很独特。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio27
: Oh my God, I’m so excited and I haven’t even switched classes yet.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪，我都还没转班呢就已经兴奋成这样了。

lines.en: : How many people are in there? Twenty? Twenty-five? Ms. Watabe’s class has like six hundred so-
lines.zh: : 你们班有多少人？二十？二十五？Watabe 老师班上有大概六百人呢，所以——

lines.en: : You’d be the fourteenth.
lines.zh: : 你会是第十四个。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio28
: Only fourteen?!
lines.zh: : 才十四个？！

lines.en: : Sensei, you know how they call people who are really good at getting along with everybody “social butterflies?”
lines.zh: : Sensei，您知道人们把特别擅长跟所有人相处的人叫什么吗？「社交蝴蝶」？

lines.en: : Well, Io here is the complete opposite.
lines.zh: : 那 Io 就是完全相反的那种。

lines.en: : It’s true. I only talk to like two people. Everyone sucks. Please save me.
lines.zh: : 没错。我只跟大概两个人说话。其他人都很讨厌。请救救我。

lines.en: : How are you two even friends?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底是怎么成为朋友的？

lines.en: : We were pen-pals when we were little!
lines.zh: : 我们小时候是笔友！

lines.en: scene utapoachesio29
: It wasn’t until Uta moved to Kumon-mi that we finally got to meet in person.
lines.zh: : 直到 Uta 搬到 Kumon-mi，我们才终于见上面。

lines.en: : She was a little shorter than I expected. And significantly more female. But I came around to liking her anyway.
lines.zh: : 她比我预想的矮一点，而且女性化得多。但总之我还是慢慢喜欢上她了。

lines.en: : Was Uta...posing as a male online?
lines.zh: : Uta 该不会……在网上装男生吧？

lines.en: scene utapoachesio30
: No...I just had a really...masculine screen name and we never really talked about our genders.
lines.zh: : 不是……我只是取了个特别……男性化的网名，而且我们从来没聊过性别这回事。

lines.en: : I kind of...thought Io was going to be a boy as well...
lines.zh: : 我其实……也以为 Io 会是个男生……

lines.en: : But yeah, weird origin story aside, thank you so much, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 总之，抛开这段奇怪的往事不说，太感谢您了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Is it okay if I call you Sensei already?
lines.zh: : 我现在就叫您 Sensei 可以吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even know what else you would call me.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道你还能叫我什么。

lines.en: : And I can move into Uta’s dorm room?
lines.zh: : 那我可以搬进 Uta 的宿舍房间吗？

lines.en: : Do you not have a roommate yet, Uta?
lines.zh: : 你还没有室友吗，Uta？

lines.en: : Well, you see...another one of the reasons I wanted Io to join our class was that I...kind of get really scared at night if there’s no one around.
lines.zh: : 那个，您看……我想让 Io 进我们班的另一个原因是……晚上身边没人的话，我真的会很害怕。

lines.en: : And I’ve got all sorts of tools and metal stuff, so I can protect her if it really comes to it.
lines.zh: : 而且我这儿有各种工具和金属玩意儿，真到了那时候我保护她就行了。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. Just focus on filling out all that paperwork or whatever it is you have to do and I’ll...
lines.zh: : 别在意这个。您专心去填那些文件、办您该办的事就好，我会……

lines.en: : ...You'll what?
lines.zh: : ……你会怎样？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I just remembered your penis.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我刚刚想起您的阴茎了。

lines.en: : Okay, I wanted you two to get along but I also wanted things to go a little differently than this.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我本来是想让你们两个好好相处的，但事情走向跟我想的不太一样啊。

lines.en: : Really? She seems pretty great to me, Uta.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我觉得她挺好的啊，Uta。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio31
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : There are a lot of words I’d use to describe myself, but “great” isn’t anywhere close to the list.
lines.zh: : 能用来形容我的词有很多，但「挺好」绝对排不上号。

lines.en: : And even if you’re only doing this because Uta put you up to it, I’m...glad you’re taking a chance on me.
lines.zh: : 就算您只是因为 Uta 怂恿才这么做的，我也……很高兴您愿意在我身上赌一把。

lines.en: : I’ll try not to get in your hair.
lines.zh: : 我会尽量不给您添麻烦。

lines.en: : And I’ll try to not come to the bathhouse with your future-classmates.
lines.zh: : 那我尽量不带着你将来的同学来澡堂。

lines.en: : Again, I don’t really care if you do. Your business is your business.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，您来不来我真不在乎。您的私事是您的私事。

lines.en: : Then I will come to the bathhouse with all of them.
lines.zh: : 那我就带着她们所有人来澡堂。

lines.en: : As long as I don’t have to clean up after you, we’re good.
lines.zh: : 只要不用我跟在您屁股后面收拾，那就没问题。

lines.en: : This is a compromise I am willing to accept.
lines.zh: : 这个妥协我可以接受。

lines.en: : Pleasure doing business with you, Io.
lines.zh: : 跟你合作愉快，Io。

lines.en: : Don’t sweat it. Stop by anytime you like.
lines.zh: : 别客气。随时欢迎您来。

lines.en: : Uta normally takes a bath around 8:00 every night, so if you stop by around then I can look the other way and let you walk in on her.
lines.zh: : Uta 一般每晚八点左右泡澡，您要是那时候过来，我可以假装没看见，放您进去撞见她。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Sweet.
lines.zh: : 不错。

lines.en: scene utapoachesio32
scene utapoachesio33
: Mom?
: I think we need to talk.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们需要谈谈。
